            User message: Hi G. Ananth!  

Your choice of the Grand Vitara in Arctic White is simply stunning! 🚘✨ This color perfectly enhances the bold design of this premium SUV, making it a standout on Bengaluru’s bustling streets. It’s clear you value sophistication and cutting-edge features, and the Grand Vitara delivers on every front.  

Here’s why this SUV is a perfect match for you:  
- EV Mode ⚡️: Enjoy seamless city drives with eco-friendly efficiency and whisper-quiet performance.  
- Head Up Display 💡: Stay focused on the road with essential driving info projected right in your line of sight.  
- Wireless Charging ✅: Effortless convenience for your devices, keeping you connected on the go.  
- 6 Airbags As Standard 🛡️: Elevated safety for you and your loved ones, ensuring peace of mind on every journey.  
- Hill-descent Control 👀: Confidence and control, even on steep terrain, for those adventurous drives.  

Best in segment features because…  
✅ Strong Hybrid Powertrain: Combines fuel efficiency of 19.38 kmpl with a powerful 1.5L engine, making every drive cost-effective and smooth.  
✅ AllGrip AWD System: Offers unmatched stability and control, perfect for Bengaluru’s diverse road conditions.  
✅ Spacious Dimensions: With a 2600 mm wheelbase, it’s designed for comfort and practicality, ideal for family or solo trips.  

We’re thrilled about your upcoming test drive! 🥳 Imagine yourself behind the wheel, experiencing the advanced technology and effortless handling firsthand. Our team is ready to ensure your evening appointment is nothing short of spectacular.  

Looking forward to seeing you drive away smiling! 😊✨
